title: Print Hello World
description: Write a program that prints the exact text `Hello, World!` to the console.
instructions: Use your language’s standard print/output statement.
Match the capitalization, comma, and exclamation mark exactly: Hello, World!
constraints: Output must be exactly one line: Hello, World!
hints: In Python use print(...), in JavaScript use console.log(...), and in Java use System.out.println(...).
Wrap the text in quotes as a string literal.

starterCode.python:
# Print Hello, World! below
print("Hello, World!")
starterCode.javascript:
// Print Hello, World! below
console.log("Hello, World!");
